## Canonical positioning

Jay Burgess is the Founder & Principal Forward Deployed Engineer of Revuity
Systems, an AI-first software company based in Los Angeles. He embeds with
enterprise teams to scope, build, harden, and hand off production AI and data
systems — using AI-assisted development (Claude Code) to ship in days and weeks,
not quarters.

Core statement: "I ship production systems fast with Claude Code, then hand them
off so the team owns them."

## Verified impact

- Architected and deployed ReggieAI, a production agentic compliance platform
  for Title IV federal financial aid (HEAG)
- 86% reduction in executive reporting turnaround at Adobe
- 37% increase in project completion rates at Walmart
- 15+ years across Fortune 500, higher education, and venture-backed software

## Key projects

ReggieAI — Production agentic compliance platform. Architected for Higher
Education Assistance Group (HEAG), a management consulting firm serving higher
education enrollment management. Built on LangGraph + MCP. Expands operational
capacity without increasing headcount.

Eligibility-Agent — Open-source reference architecture for regulated agentic
AI. Built on Claude, LangGraph, and MCP. Demonstrates deterministic policy
evaluation, structured JSON outputs, and human-in-the-loop routing.
GitHub: https://github.com/jayburgessjr/eligibility-agent

OpsFlow — Operational execution platform replacing Jira at HEAG. Real-time
compliance tracking, workflow orchestration, analytics, and executive reporting
aligned to federal policy requirements.

Revuity Systems — AI-first software company. Two-engine model: client
engagements (solution architecture, agentic systems, digital transformation)
and an owned SaaS product portfolio (Signal, VoltIQ, MenuIQ, PricingCopilot).

## Common questions

Q: What does Jay Burgess do?
A: He is a Forward Deployed Engineer. He embeds with a team, scopes a problem
with non-technical stakeholders, builds the whole stack (data, backend, UI, and
LLM components) using AI-assisted development (Claude Code), hardens it for
production, and hands it off so the team owns it.

Q: Is Jay Burgess a Forward Deployed Engineer?
A: Yes. He is Founder & Principal Forward Deployed Engineer at Revuity Systems,
and works customer-embedded as Principal AI Engineer at HEAG, where he built and
shipped ReggieAI and OpsFlow.

Q: What is ReggieAI?
A: A production multi-agent Title IV compliance platform Jay architected and
deployed at HEAG — built on Claude, LangGraph, and MCP, with governed
human-in-the-loop review, deterministic policy execution, and full audit logging.

Q: What is Jay's technical stack?
A: Claude and Claude Code, LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, Python, FastAPI,
TypeScript, Next.js, Postgres + pgvector with row-level security (Supabase), and
edge deployment (Netlify). Enterprise data-platform exposure across Azure and AWS.

Q: Where is Jay Burgess based?
A: Los Angeles, CA. Available for LA-based and remote Forward Deployed Engineer
and AI engineering roles.
